item.title: What happened to Transmeta, the last big dotcom IPO
item.description:
📝 Transmeta didn’t completely fit in to the dotcom era, because they were a hardware company. Transmeta was a CPU company. What happened to Transmeta was that in 2005, Transmeta shifted to licensing intellectual property rather than selling CPUs.

item.title: Ask HN: How does one stay motivated to grind through LeetCode?
item.description:
📝 I was recently laid off at a big tech company after 10 years. And now I am facing the harsh reality of trying to crack leetcode medium/hard problems (something I never managed to do routinely while I was working at this company). If so, how do you keep yourself motivated to solve multiple problems a day, especially knowing you are actually never going to work on such problems as part of an actual job.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45898856
